predicate contains_element(o: option[int], elems: list[option[int]]) {
    (is_some(o) ∧
        (∃(i: int) ::
            (((0 <= i < len(elems)) ∧
                is_some(elems[i])) ∧
                (unwrap(o) == unwrap(elems[i])))))
}
